name: ck-code-lite
description: Minimal workflow: start -> design -> build -> ship. One architecture doc (split into areas as it grows), one flat plan file, every bookkeeping step scripted. Keeps the guarantees that matter — a failing test before the code, an isolated QA pass, and manual sign-off before anything is marked done.

theme.title: ck look
theme.description: Flat-glyph tool rows and groups, workflow words on the spinner, and the builders' task lists in the band, in ck-code-lite projects.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show the task in progress, the plan's counts and the next build command above the prompt.

compact_after_waves.title: Compact after a wave run
compact_after_waves.description: Compact the session once a /ck-code-lite:build wave run finishes with nothing left in progress.

cost_guard.title: Cost guard
cost_guard.description: Cap every request and subagent at high effort, ask before any Fable dispatch, and give built-in subagents a cheap model when none is named.
